ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Opera Crew Call III Description: Experience in backstage support of the UI Opera program production of Calista Meets Thurs, Apr 14 ? Sunday, May 1, 2011 Note: The actual class schedule will be distributed at the first class meeting on Thurs, April 14, 2011 at 5:00pm. Approximately 63 hours over 11-12 days of internship experience at KCPA will be required; class will most often be in the evening, and may last until 11pm. Enrollees will be required to work backstage for 4 performances of the opera.
